package main

import (
    "context"
    "errors"
    "net/http"
    "net/http/httptest"
    "strings"
    "testing"
    "time"

    sessions "github.com/soccer99/go-django-sessions"
)

func TestProtectedRoutes(t *testing.T) {
    for _, scenario := range []string{"valid", "custom cookie", "missing cookie", "invalid key", "expired", "bad signature", "password changed", "inactive", "removed backend", "missing hash", "missing session", "deleted user", "storage failure", "user storage failure", "configuration failure"} {
        t.Run(scenario, func(t *testing.T) {
            user := &sessions.AuthUser{ID: "1", Password: "encoded-password", IsActive: true}
            options := sessions.SessionOptions{SecretKey: "framework-test-secret"}
            data := map[string]any{
                "_auth_user_id": "1", "_auth_user_backend": sessions.ModelBackend,
                "_auth_user_hash": sessions.SessionAuthHash(user.Password, options.SecretKey),
            }
            if scenario == "missing hash" { delete(data, "_auth_user_hash") }
            raw, err := sessions.EncodeSession(data, options)
            if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
            row := &sessions.SessionRecord{Data: raw, ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(time.Hour)}
            auth := sessions.Authenticator{
                Options: options, AuthenticationBackends: []string{sessions.ModelBackend},
                LoadSession: func(context.Context, string) (*sessions.SessionRecord, error) { return row, nil },
                LoadUser: func(context.Context, string) (*sessions.AuthUser, error) { return user, nil },
            }
            want := http.StatusUnauthorized
            switch scenario {
            case "valid": want = http.StatusOK
            case "custom cookie": auth.CookieName = "custom_session"; want = http.StatusOK
            case "expired": row.ExpiresAt = time.Now().Add(-time.Second)
            case "bad signature": row.Data += "x"
            case "password changed": user.Password = "new-password"
            case "inactive": user.IsActive = false
            case "removed backend": auth.AuthenticationBackends = []string{"other.Backend"}
            case "missing session": row = nil
            case "deleted user": user = nil
            case "storage failure":
                auth.LoadSession = func(context.Context, string) (*sessions.SessionRecord, error) { return nil, errors.New("private database error") }
                want = http.StatusInternalServerError
            case "user storage failure":
                auth.LoadUser = func(context.Context, string) (*sessions.AuthUser, error) { return nil, errors.New("private database error") }
                want = http.StatusInternalServerError
            case "configuration failure": auth.LoadUser = nil; want = http.StatusInternalServerError
            }
            req := httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/api/profile", nil)
            if scenario != "missing cookie" {
                key := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345"
                if scenario == "invalid key" { key = "bad" }
                cookieName := auth.CookieName
                if cookieName == "" { cookieName = "sessionid" }
                req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: cookieName, Value: key})
            }
            // FRAMEWORK_REQUEST
            if status != want { t.Fatalf("status=%d want=%d body=%s", status, want, body) }
            if strings.Contains(body, "private") || strings.Contains(body, "encoded-password") { t.Fatalf("leaked internal data: %s", body) }
            if want == http.StatusOK && !strings.Contains(body, "1") { t.Fatalf("missing identity: %s", body) }
            if want != http.StatusOK && strings.Contains(body, "user id:") { t.Fatalf("protected handler ran: %s", body) }
        })
    }
}
